page.layout: One page of text: running head INDEX at top; index lines in the upper block with page numbers at right; FINIS centred; errata heading and two lines centred; woodcut ornament below. Blocks in reading order, no margin notes.

main_text.l: Vult Deus, vel sinendo vel faciendo. 579
main_text.head: FINIS.
Errata quaedam Typographica lector facile agnoscet, atque ignoscet benevolè.

page.notes: The running head "INDEX" is set as a title at the top. The index numbers at the right edge are partly cut off and the last one may read 579 or 579. Some words in the index lines are italic in the print and set as italic here only in the printed heading style. The woodcut ornament below the errata is not transcribed.
